title: 第449章 小云云的首富计划第443章 大帝齐至
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
lines: 秦然陡然站起身。
意念一动，他的皮肤肉眼可见地蠕动了起来，原本晶莹如玉的皮肤下，瞬间钻出了一片片瓶盖大小的土黄色龙鳞。
密密麻麻，遍布全身。
鳞片上，雕琢着一只只栩栩如生的黄色龙形图腾！
这些图腾仿佛活过来一般，在鳞片上游动咆哮，张牙舞爪，散发出阵阵浑厚霸道之力。
藏在身体各处的九颗神岳心核，似被鳞片上的浑厚土黄色灵力牵动，爆发出了耀眼的土黄色光芒。
神岳心核中的灵力，与龙鳞上的灵力彼此呼应，威压同时大涨。
嗷吼！！！
心脏中，龙吼声轰然炸响。
黄龙器灵咆哮着，龙鳞与身体彻底融合，转瞬之间，已臻至最完美状态。
秦然的境界随之稳固。
四阶准帝境巅峰！
他抬起左手，指尖处亮起一道凌厉的暗金色光芒，他并指如剑，用五分力朝手臂上的龙鳞刺了下去。
大夏龙雀的剑气刺在龙鳞上。
没有震耳的金铁交鸣声，也没有爆发出太强声势，剑气落在龙鳞上仿佛泥牛入海，这足以刺穿空间的剑气，竟是直接被龙鳞诡异的吞噬了……
秦然瞪圆了眼，“居然…无伤？”
他不信邪似的加大了几分力，用上了七成力道。
剑气刺在龙鳞上，他的身体感到了一股微微的刺痛感，但除此之外，不再有任何异样。
他继续加力，这次用上了十成力！
剑气刺向龙鳞。
龙鳞中的土灵力大涨，九岳狱神阵随之发动，二者层层叠加相互增幅。
高阶帝阵和高阶帝器，同时发力，叠加后的土灵力，已雄浑到难以想象的程度。
剑气落在龙鳞上，速度骤减，破坏力也被土灵力层层压缩…再压缩……
最终，在龙鳞上留下了一道极浅的白痕。
依旧…难以破防！
小云云在一旁早已看傻，“大夏龙雀算得上是中阶帝器中的最强杀器，你的十成力居然破不了防御…这不是做梦吧。”
秦然意念一动，身上的龙鳞消失。
他的掌心中，多出了一个拳头大小的迷你土黄色甲胄。
甲胄虽小，却重逾万钧。
【玄天土龙甲】
【品阶】：高阶帝器
【说明】：穿戴后，龙鳞守护全身，获得至强防御
【技能1】：化龙——化身玄天土龙最强形态，攻防皆达到巅峰
【技能2】：万化归无（被动）——当遭受到的攻击超过龙鳞承受限值，将自动均匀分散至全身10086片龙鳞上，伤害值降至最低
“高阶帝器……”小云云呆滞的看着秦然掌心的土黄色甲胄。
“这小鼎，居然真能将中阶准帝器强化至高阶帝器的程度……”
“小仙仙！”小云云眼睛亮晶晶的抓住秦然胳膊，“姐姐刚才的提议，你真不考虑考虑？”
“你去征服那个女人，让她保护你，你来帮其他人提升装备品质赚钱，你们两个相互配合，估计用不了多久，你就可以成为玄黄大世界首富！”
“到时候，你要人脉有人脉，要灵石有灵石，复兴云族也轻轻松松。”
“这想法如何？”
秦然淡淡看向女人，“她若要抢我的鼎呢？”
小云云一脸笃定，“不可能！”
“为何？”
content_en:
Qin Ran suddenly stood up.
With a thought, his skin squirmed visibly to the naked eye, and pieces of khaki dragon scales the size of bottle caps emerged from under his originally crystal-clear skin.
Densely packed all over the body.
On the scales, lifelike yellow dragon-shaped totems are carved!
These totems seemed to come alive, swimming and roaring on their scales, baring their teeth and claws, exuding bursts of powerful and domineering power.
The nine Shenyue Heart Cores hidden throughout the body seemed to be affected by the thick earth-yellow spiritual power on the scales, bursting out with dazzling earth-yellow light.
The spiritual power in Shenyue's heart core echoed with the spiritual power on the dragon scales, and the pressure surged at the same time.
Ouch! ! !
In his heart, the roar of the dragon exploded.
The Huanglong Weapon Spirit roared, its dragon scales completely integrated with its body, and in an instant, it reached its most perfect state.
Qin Ran's realm then stabilized.
The peak of the fourth level quasi-emperor realm!
He raised his left hand, and a sharp dark golden light lit up at his fingertips. He pointed like a sword and stabbed the dragon scales on his arm with five points of force.
puff! !
The Daxia Dragon Bird's sword energy pierced the dragon's scales.
There was no ear-splitting sound of gold and iron, nor was it too powerful. The sword energy fell on the dragon scales like a mud cow falling into the sea. The sword energy, which was enough to pierce the space, was directly and strangely swallowed by the dragon scales...
Qin Ran's eyes widened, "Unexpectedly...no injuries?"
As if he didn't believe in evil, he increased his strength a little, using 70% of his strength.
The sword energy pierced the dragon scales, and he felt a slight tingling sensation in his body, but other than that, there was no other difference.
He continued to increase his strength, this time using 100% of his strength!
puff! !
The sword energy stabbed the dragon scale.
The earth spiritual power in the dragon scales increased greatly, and the Jiuyue Prison God Formation was activated accordingly, and the two were superimposed to increase each other's strength.
The high-level imperial formation and the high-level imperial weapon exerted force at the same time, and the superimposed earth spiritual power was so powerful that it was unimaginable.
The sword energy fell on the dragon scales, its speed dropped sharply, and its destructive power was compressed layer by layer by the earth's spiritual power...and then compressed...
In the end, a very shallow white mark was left on the dragon scales.
Still...difficult to break through!
Xiao Yunyun looked dumbfounded, "The Great Xia Dragon Bird is the most powerful weapon among the mid-level imperial weapons. You can't break the defense with 100% of your power... Isn't this a dream?"
With a thought, Qin Ran's dragon scales disappeared.
In his palm, a mini khaki armor the size of a fist appeared.
Although the armor is small, it weighs more than ten thousand pieces.
[Xuantian Earth Dragon Armor]
[Grade]: High-level imperial weapon
[Description]: After wearing it, the dragon scales will protect the whole body and gain the strongest defense.
[Skill 1]: Dragon Transformation - Incarnate into the strongest form of the Xuantian Earth Dragon, reaching the peak of both offense and defense.
[Skill 2]: Everything will turn into nothingness (Passive) - When the attack received exceeds the endurance limit of dragon scales, it will be automatically and evenly distributed to the 10086 dragon scales on the body, and the damage value will be reduced to the minimum.
"High-level imperial weapon..." Xiao Yunyun looked blankly at the khaki armor in Qin Ran's palm.
"This small cauldron can actually enhance the mid-level quasi-imperial weapon to the level of a high-level imperial weapon..."
"Xiao Xianxian!" Xiao Yunyun grabbed Qin Ran's arm with bright eyes, "You really don't want to consider the proposal that my sister just made?"
"You go conquer that woman and let her protect you. You help other people improve the quality of their equipment and make money. The two of you cooperate with each other. It won't take long for you to become the richest man in the Xuanhuang World!"
"When the time comes, if you have connections and spiritual stones, it will be easy to revive the Yun Clan."
"What do you think?"
Kieran looked at the woman calmly, "What if she wants to steal my cauldron?"
Xiao Yunyun said with determination, "Impossible!"
"Why?"
